_comment: Chapter 6 of the story revamp (docs/gameplay/23 §4): F27, the second mirror shard (mirror_shards + 1).

text.zh_TW: 祈禱廳的長椅底下，一片碎鏡在發光。鏡面上浮出幾個字：「……謝謝你，里歐。再一片……」
text.en: Under a pew in the Hall of Prayers, a mirror shard glows. Words float up on its surface: "...Thank you, Leo. One more..."
